clue.text: Shakespearean actress?

parts.note: Shakespeare's wife shares her name with a modern Hollywood film star, so the question mark lets 'Shakespearean' mean married to the Bard rather than playing his roles

explanation.surface: A quiz question asking for a performer known for playing Shakespeare's heroines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shakespearean actress' suggests a stage performer of the plays; instead the answer is the playwright's wife, whose name is also that of a famous American film actress.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the Bard's spouse and to a present-day Oscar-winning star of film.

clue.text: Friend invested in gold rings, originally a dabbler

indicators.note: something invested in another is placed within it, so the friend goes inside the gold

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold
a mate is a friend

indicators.note: the original letter of a word is its first one, here of rings

explanation.surface: A pal puts money into gold jewellery, though only as a hobbyist investor.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-professional who takes up a pursuit casually is a dabbler in it.

clue.text: Don raised tennis umpire's call?

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising a word sets its letters upwards, reading them backwards

parts.note: to don clothes is to put them on

explanation.surface: A university don lifts up the call made by a tennis umpire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Don' looks like a university teacher but is the verb meaning to put on clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Umpires shout this when a ball has bounced twice before the player struck it, so the rally is lost.

clue.text: Stage entertainer is tense after python uncoiled

indicators.note: signals that the tense letter and is come after the snake's rearranged letters
a snake that uncoils loses its shape, so the letters of python are rearranged

parts.note: T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: A performer gets nervous after a python unwinds itself on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uncoiled' turns PYTHON into HYPNOT; 'tense' looks like nervousness but is T.
explanation.definitionFit: A mesmerist who puts volunteers into a trance is a classic variety-show act.

clue.text: Job of Tut, primarily, when king

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so the opening letter of Tut is taken

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as he left'
K is the chess and card abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A question about what work Tutankhamun did when he was a pharaoh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tut' and 'king' together evoke Tutankhamun, but Tut only supplies its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of work to be done, or an assignment, is a synonym for a job.

clue.text: A lovable rogue, especially

indicators.note: something rogue has gone astray and out of control, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A charming scoundrel, in particular.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rogue' reads as a noun for the lovable rascal, but works as the adjective signalling rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something matters more than everything else is a phrasal synonym for in particular.

clue.text: Greek character employed by local pharmacy

indicators.note: the letters are taken up inside the words that follow, spanning local and pharmacy

explanation.surface: A Greek person works at the neighbourhood chemist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' looks like a person, but means a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the first letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Brief argument in place where shares are traded?

definitions.meaning: a short, sharp ... of words between two people
a stock market building, such as the Royal one in London

explanation.surface: A short row breaks out on the trading floor.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a quick spat of words and a marketplace for stocks and commodities.

clue.text: Hide mostly hidden

indicators.note: most of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: to secrete something is to hide it away

explanation.surface: An instruction to conceal something that is already largely concealed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something kept from others' knowledge is concealed, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Article with advice regarding a cocktail snack

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
a tip is a piece of advice
as to means regarding or concerning

explanation.surface: A magazine piece offering tips about canapés.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian appetisers of cured meats and olives are served before a meal or with drinks.

clue.text: Brownie's photographs I initially enlarged

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is'; a brownie is a household sprite of folklore

parts.note: pix is informal for pictures or photographs

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of enlarged

explanation.surface: A Girl Guide's snapshots, which I first had blown up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brownie' suggests a junior Girl Guide or a Kodak camera, but is the folklore sprite.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are small mischievous fairy folk of British folklore.

clue.text: Use device to track me on the way back

indicators.note: tracking is following, so the stratagem comes after the reversed pronoun
returning means the word me is read backwards

parts.note: a ploy is a device or stratagem

explanation.surface: Someone is told to use a tracker to follow them home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'device' suggests a GPS gadget but means a ruse.
explanation.definitionFit: To employ something is to make use of it; both are verbs.

clue.text: Figure of speech that's upset mother, about father retiring

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go about, or around, the reversed father
upsetting something knocks it over, so the letters of mother are rearranged
retiring means drawing back, so the word for father is read backwards

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A remark has upset Mum, regarding Dad withdrawing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns MOTHER into METHOR, which goes about AP, PA reversed by 'retiring'.
explanation.definitionFit: A figurative comparison, such as 'a heart of stone', is a classic figure of speech.

clue.text: Country club, briefly after game

indicators.note: signals that the shortened club follows the game

parts.note: RU is rugby union

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: a stick is a club or cudgel

explanation.surface: A country club, mentioned quickly after a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country' as a noun pulls towards nation; here it is an adjective meaning rural.
explanation.definitionFit: Rustic means rural, as in country cottages or country life.

clue.text: Supplier of caviar, one who operates across heart of Vietnam

indicators.note: the surgeon goes across, spanning the central letter

parts.note: a surgeon performs operations

indicators.note: the heart is the middle letter of Vietnam

explanation.surface: A caviar trader working across central Vietnam.
explanation.definitionFit: This large fish is the source of the roe sold as caviar.

clue.text: Fantastic article about new musical instrument

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go round the letter for new
fantastic means fanciful or wild, so the letters of article are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rave review of a newspaper piece about a new instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fantastic' turns ARTICLE into CLARIET, which goes about N.
explanation.definitionFit: A single-reed woodwind is a musical instrument.

clue.text: Cook married a character in a long complicated procedure

parts.note: to rig, like to cook the books, is to falsify
a role is a character in a play

explanation.surface: A chef marries an actor, which turns into a drawn-out ordeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cook' looks like a kitchen verb but means to falsify.
explanation.definitionFit: A rigmarole is a tediously involved process or palaver.

clue.text: Check on reportedly pricey animal

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed after, so the second piece follows

parts.note: to rein in is to check or restrain

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so the word for pricey is said aloud

parts.note: dear means expensive

explanation.surface: Checking on what sounds like an expensive creature.
explanation.definitionFit: Caribou of the Arctic are hoofed animals famous for pulling Santa's sleigh.

clue.text: Unlawful occupant, stockier

definitions.meaning: someone living in a building without permission or title
more squat in build, shorter and broader

explanation.surface: A trespassing resident who happens to be rather thickset.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a person who occupies property illegally; the other is the comparative of squat, short and thick.

clue.text: Force small lock

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as in clothing sizes
a tress is a lock of hair

explanation.surface: Someone forcing a little padlock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lock' suggests a door fastening but means a lock of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: In physics and engineering, stress is the force acting on a body per unit area.

clue.text: Monstrous female and two sons therefore turned back

indicators.note: turned back means the combined letters read in reverse

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son, twice
ergo is Latin for therefore

explanation.surface: A frightening woman and her two boys, who therefore retreated.
explanation.definitionFit: A she-monster of fairy tales, the female counterpart of a giant man-eater.

clue.text: Apologetic about church suggesting witchcraft

indicators.note: the word for apologetic goes about, around, the church letters

parts.note: sorry means apologetic
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Remorse regarding the church hints at black magic.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorcery is magic using evil spirits, a synonym for witchcraft.

clue.text: Army unit's diet close to front

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is'; a large army formation

parts.note: a regimen is a prescribed diet

indicators.note: the close is the end, so the last letter of front

explanation.surface: Soldiers' rations near the front line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'close to front' reads as near the battle line but gives the last letter of front.
explanation.definitionFit: A permanent military unit, typically of several battalions.

clue.text: Below zero in America after end of snowstorm

indicators.note: signals that in and the country follow the last letter of snowstorm
the end of a word is its final letter, here of snowstorm

parts.note: US is the United States of America

explanation.surface: Temperatures in the US drop after a snowstorm.
explanation.definitionFit: A negative number, as in minus five degrees, lies below zero.

clue.text: Despicable person, that woman? On the contrary

parts.note: a rat is a contemptible person
her is the pronoun for that woman

explanation.surface: Is she a rotten character? Quite the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as a reply, the word means instead or on the contrary, correcting the previous statement.

clue.text: Difficult to carry round store

indicators.note: carrying something means holding it, so the word for difficult holds the ring letter

parts.note: hard means difficult
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: It is hard to carry stuff around a shop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'store' looks like a shop but is a stockpile.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoard is a stockpile or cache of something saved up.

clue.text: Couple's piano tune

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is'; a couple is two of a kind

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
an air is a tune

explanation.surface: Two people's song played on the piano.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things or people together make a duo or brace.

clue.text: Power in early woodenheaded golf club

indicators.note: the power letter goes inside the word for early

parts.note: soon means early, before long

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned golf club with a wooden head and a powerful swing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'woodenheaded' suggests stupidity; here it describes the club's head.
explanation.definitionFit: This was an old lofted golf club with a wooden head, used for short approach shots.

clue.text: Complicated tale a bore spun

indicators.note: spun means whirled round, so the letters of tale a bore are rearranged

explanation.surface: A long-winded story told by a dull person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spun' suggests spinning a yarn, fitting the tale, but signals rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Something detailed and intricate in design is complicated.

clue.text: Easy to understand addict attending pre-season game?

parts.note: a user is a drug addict
a friendly is a non-competitive match, often played before the season starts

explanation.surface: A drug user going to a warm-up match, made simple.
explanation.walkthrough: A friendly is a non-league football match, common before the British season.
explanation.definitionFit: Software or instructions that are simple for people to operate are described this way.
